context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure package's normalizeCart utility function, including importing it from the package, verifying correct field mappings (id as string, prices divided by 100, taxesIncluded: true), and line item normalization including discounted prices and image URL formatting.

checklist.name: Import normalizeCart
checklist.description: The solution imports `normalizeCart` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` (via the utils path) and calls it with a Vendure Order/CartFragment object.

checklist.name: id toString conversion
checklist.description: The normalized cart's `id` is the string representation of the Vendure Order's numeric `id` (e.g. 42 becomes '42').

checklist.name: Prices divided by 100
checklist.description: The `subtotalPrice`, `totalPrice`, and `lineItemsSubtotalPrice` are all divided by 100 from the Vendure `subTotalWithTax` and `totalWithTax` values.

checklist.name: taxesIncluded: true
checklist.description: The normalized cart always has `taxesIncluded: true` regardless of the input order's tax configuration.

checklist.name: Image URL with ?preset=thumb
checklist.description: Line item image URLs have `?preset=thumb` appended to `featuredAsset.preview`.
